limitations: Selected first-party code/configuration only; archives and outputs excluded.
Credential stores, private documents, media, symlinks, and top-level generated state excluded.
No full Git-history or dependency-advisory audit; no automatic remediation.
AI triage is advisory; daily/full-review mode processes every static candidate in bounded batches.
Ordinary scans cap AI triage at 12 candidates. A scan is not a security certification.

dependencies: No third-party runtime dependencies in shipped Python code; runtime/model installs are separate and require their own advisories.
